cohort: The study enrolled late preterm (gestational age 34+0/7-36+6/7 weeks) and moderately preterm (gestational age 32+0/7-33+6/7 weeks) infants with respiratory distress syndrome, with term infants with no lung disease as controls.
finding: Late preterm infants with respiratory distress syndrome had DSPC and SP-B levels similar to moderately preterm infants, and early administration, lower FiO2 threshold, and better oxygenation prior to surfactant treatment were associated with a better response to surfactant therapy.
gest_age: 32+0/7 to 36+6/7 weeks (for preterm infants), term (for controls)
